theater: 斯摩棱斯克土地與奧爾沙河谷

battle.name: 第四次莫斯科-立陶宛戰爭
battle.theater: 斯摩棱斯克土地與奧爾沙河谷
battle.brief: 一五一二年底莫斯科大公瓦西里三世東征立陶宛，圍攻東方門戶斯摩棱斯克；一五一四年七月城陷，俄軍乘勢西進，卻在同年九月八日被波蘭-立陶宛聯軍在奧爾沙擊潰，軍營與三百門砲全部被奪。聯軍骨幹是三萬餘騎兵，會戰火力仍靠火繩步槍；輪發手槍只配給火槍隊軍官與近衛，用於近身自衛與對付落馬騎士。

kit.name: 輪發手槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與近衛。

countries: 此役的交戰方大致是三方：莫斯科大公國與立窩尼亞騎士團一方，對立陶宛大公國、波蘭王國與克里米亞汗國一方。莫斯科一側靠服役土地與屯田供養的世襲軍，按城市徵召役夫，一五一四年會戰時至少牽動諾夫哥羅德、普斯科夫、大魯基、科斯特羅馬、穆羅姆、博羅夫斯克、特韋爾、沃洛克、羅斯拉夫、維亞濟馬、佩列亞斯拉夫爾、科洛姆納、雅羅斯拉夫爾與斯塔羅杜布等十四城的兵力，再加波亞爾家族子弟湊成的重騎；瓦西里三世同時要在南方草原分兵盯住克里米亞、喀山與諾蓋方向，兵源調度一直緊張。立陶宛一側則是大、小貴族自備的土地軍，重騎以長柄波蘭矛與板甲為主，波蘭王室另出正規軍、貴族私兵與王宮近衛，傭兵步兵來自波希米亞與西里西亞；克里米亞汗國並非主角，而是齊格蒙特一世用來牽制莫斯科草原邊防的外援。立窩尼亞騎士團站在莫斯科一方，說穿了是因為大公想收編騎士團，團方則拿莫斯科的出兵作籌碼：團長海因里希·馮·加倫在一五一二年的失利後被解職，西法蘭西出身的瓦爾特·馮·普萊滕貝格一五一三年接任。另外還有一支武裝與此役糾纏到底：普魯士的條頓騎士團，其大團長阿爾布雷希特拒絕承認波蘭的宗主權，一五一九至二一年爆發波蘭-條頓戰爭，神聖羅馬帝國皇帝馬克西米利安一世因而與瓦西里三世結盟，等於替莫斯科解除了西線牽制。
countriesEn: The belligerents on this theatre fall into three bodies: the Grand Duchy of Moscow together with the Livonian Order on one side, and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, the Kingdom of Poland and the Crimean Khanate on the other. Moscow's army was a service army fed by service land and military farms; its levies were raised town by town, and by the battle of 1514 at least fourteen towns were drawn upon — Novgorod, Pskov, Velikie Luki, Kostroma, Murom, Borovsk, Tver, Volok, Roslavl, Vyazma, Pereyaslavl, Kolomna, Yaroslavl and Starodub — with the armoured horse of the boyar households added on top. Vasili III simultaneously had to keep men in the southern steppe watching the Crimea, Kazan and Nogai, and the manpower was permanently strained. Lithuania's host was the land army of the magnates and the lesser nobility, heavy cavalry with the long kontusz and plate armour; the Polish crown added a regular army, the private retainers of the magnate households and the royal guard, and the mercenary infantry was hired from Bohemia and Silesia. The Crimean Khanate was not a principal in the war but money spent by Sigismund I to pin the Muscovite steppe frontier. The Livonian Order sat on the Muscovite side for a reason of its own: the Grand Duke wanted to absorb the order, and the order used Muscovite troops as a bargaining chip. Its master Heinrich von Galen was removed after the disasters of 1512, and the Westphalian Walter von Plettenberg was elected in 1513. One more armed body is tangled in this war from beginning to end, the Teutonic Order: its grand master Albrecht of Prussia refused to acknowledge the Polish overlordship required of him, the Polish–Teutonic War of 1519–1521 followed, and the emperor Maximilian I allied with Vasili III, which released Moscow from any pressure in the west.
people: 主帥一邊是莫斯科大公瓦西里三世與波蘭國王兼立陶宛大公齊格蒙特一世這兩個對手。瓦西里三世自一五〇五年即位後一直覬覦波蘭王位，把此役當成向西擴張的總攻；齊格蒙特一世則要保住立陶宛東方的門戶。立陶宛最高軍事首領康斯坦丁·伊萬諾維奇·奧斯特羅斯基是全場最關鍵的指揮官：一五一二年間他率騎兵掃平西維利亞並打敗約六千人的俄軍，一五一四年又統率大公國與波蘭的聯軍在奧爾沙取勝。波蘭方面，楊·希維爾霍夫斯基率領的是王國正規軍，沃伊切赫·桑波利尼斯基管的是貴族私兵與王室近衛；立陶宛方面除奧斯特羅斯基外，還有野戰軍事首領耶日·拉齊維烏。莫斯科一邊，會戰統帥是宮廷軍人伊萬·切利亞德寧與王公米哈伊爾·布爾加科夫-戈利察；斯摩棱斯克攻下後，瓦西里·舒伊斯基被派去做該城攝政，而早在一五〇八年就叛投莫斯科的米哈伊爾·格林斯基本以為攝政非己莫屬，結果反被俄羅斯人囚禁，頭腦與人脈一同斷送。立窩尼亞一端，海因里希·馮·加倫在一五一二年被解職，瓦爾特·馮·普萊滕貝格於一五一三年接任，成為日後領軍反攻的關鍵人物。另有齊格蒙特·馮·赫爾伯斯坦這位神聖羅馬帝國的外交官兼情報提供者，他留下的《莫斯科史評論》是此役最原始、也最需要打折扣的數字來源；南方草原上則有克里米亞汗明里·格來與繼任者馬赫默德·格來，以及一五二一年率立陶宛軍參與進攻的達什科維。
peopleEn: The two antagonists at the head of this war were the Muscovite grand prince Vasili III and Sigismund I, king of Poland and grand duke of Lithuania. Vasili III, on the throne since 1505, had coveted the Polish crown for years and treated this war as the general offensive of his western expansion; Sigismund I, for his part, had to save Lithuania's eastern door. The decisive commander of the campaign was Konstanty Ostrogski, grand hetman of Lithuania: in 1512 he took his cavalry through Severia and defeated a Russian force of some six thousand, and in 1514 he commanded the Lithuanian–Polish allied army to victory at Orsha. On the Polish side Janusz Świerczowski led the regular royal army and Wojciech Sampoliński the private detachments and the household troops of the magnates; on the Lithuanian side Ostrogski was joined by field hetman Jerzy Radziwiłł. The Muscovite army at Orsha was commanded by the courtier Ivan Chelyadnin and by Prince Mikhail Bulgakov-Golitsa, and after Smolensk fell, Vasily Nemoy Shuysky was installed as its vicegerent. Michael Glinski, who had fled to Moscow as early as 1508 and had counted on the same appointment, was instead imprisoned by the Russians, losing his position and his connections together. On the Livonian side Heinrich von Galen was removed in 1512 and Walter von Plettenberg took over in 1513, becoming the man who would lead the counter-offensive. Sigismund von Herberstein, a diplomat and informant of the Holy Roman Empire, supplies the earliest and in places the most inflated figures in his Rerum Moscoviticarum Commentarii; on the southern steppe stand the Crimean khans Meñli I Giray and his successor Mehmed I Giray, and Dashkovich, who led the Lithuanian contingent in the campaign of 1521.
kits: 此役的裝備骨架是火繩槍、長矛與騎槍三者。莫斯科一側的火槍手用俄式的火藥槍，一種以火繩點火的滑膛長槍，射手站成稀疏散兵線，靠裝填手機關與支架分組射擊；步兵另有長矛、闊刃長柄刀與弩，貴族重騎用板甲、長柄波蘭矛與彎刀，並以手槍作為騎戰的最後手段。立陶宛-波蘭聯軍的骨幹是重騎兵：三萬二千五百名騎兵配上三萬五千人總兵力中的大半，另有波希米亞與西里西亞的三千名傭兵步兵，步騎比例說明雙方都仍舊是靠騎兵決戰的時代。砲兵是此役最關鍵的變數：莫斯科圍斯摩棱斯克時集中了能夠射程的攻城重砲，奧爾沙一役聯軍更奪下莫斯科軍營與全部三百門砲，林中隱蔽的砲兵在追擊階段直接決定了崩盤。卡面這件輪發手槍恰好站在這套裝備的縫隙裏：它是十五世紀末至十六世紀初在低地國家與德意志出現的後膛機構，靠一條發條帶動的火鐧打火，不必用火繩，但每次上弦要轉動多圈、必須另帶上弦匙，機件脆而怕濕，火藥消耗又大，價錢遠高於火繩手槍，因此只配給火槍隊的軍官與近衛——這正是它在德意志傭兵營、波蘭貴族侍從與立窩尼亞騎士團軍官手中最早出現的理由；西班牙方面要到一五三〇年代把它制度化進步兵方陣，才真正成為卡面上標示的那件西班牙兵器。就此役而言，直接的配發紀錄有限，可以確定的是：會戰中真正交火的仍是火繩步槍與火繩手槍，輪發手槍在雨雪、大霧與夜戰裡射擊可靠是它的真優點，而射速、射程與耐用性都不足以替代步槍，位置只在軍官自衛、近衛值夜與對付落馬騎士。
kitsEn: The equipment skeleton of this war is the combination of matchlock gun, pike and cavalry lance. The Muscovite musketeers carried the Russian matchlock arquebus, a heavy smooth-bored piece fired from a match, the shooters standing in a thin skirmish line and working in sections off their rests and supports; the foot had pikes, broad-bladed pole blades and crossbows, while the armoured boyar horse carried plate, the long kontusz and a sabre, with a pistol as the last resort of the mounted fight. The backbone of the Lithuanian–Polish allied army was its cavalry: thirty-two thousand five hundred horsemen against a total force of some thirty-five thousand, plus three thousand mercenary infantry from Bohemia and Silesia, a ratio that shows how far both sides still fought their war on horseback. Artillery was the decisive variable of the campaign: Moscow massed siege guns of sufficient range against Smolensk, and at Orsha the allies seized the Muscovite camp and all three hundred of its guns, the hidden artillery in the wood deciding the collapse in the pursuit stage. The wheel-lock pistol on this card sits exactly in the gap in that equipment: a rear-locking mechanism that appeared in the Low Countries and Germany at the close of the fifteenth and the opening of the sixteenth century, fired by a spring-driven frizzen instead of a match, but slow to cock through many turns, needing a separate key carried on the person, fragile and vulnerable to damp, thirsty for powder and many times the price of a matchlock pistol, and therefore issued only to the officers of the firearm companies and to the guards. That is why it appeared first in the hands of German mercenary captains, Polish noble retainers and the officers of the Livonian Order; it took another two decades for Spain to write it into the order of battle of its foot, and only then did it become the Spanish weapon named on this card. For this particular war the records of issue are thin; what can be established is that the fighting power that actually met the enemy was still matchlock arquebus and matchlock pistol, that the real advantage of the wheel-lock was to shoot reliably in rain, snow, fog and at night, and that its rate of fire, range and durability were in no position to replace the muskets, leaving it with the officer's self-defence, the guard's night watch and the shooting of unhorsed riders as its whole occupation.
tactics: 莫斯科的打法是沿維捷布斯克—斯摩棱斯克大道縱隊推進。聯軍在貝雷津納河、博布爾河與德魯特河幾個渡口試探，莫斯科避戰不接，推進到奧爾沙與杜布羅夫納之間的克拉皮夫納河扎營；切利亞德寧判斷聯軍必從第聶伯河兩座橋之一過河，便分兵守住這兩個渡口，結果聯軍在更北面架起兩座浮橋渡河，繞到俄軍側後，把分兵防守的弱點變成致命傷。會戰陣形上，聯軍把大公國方面一萬六千名騎兵擺在中央正面，波蘭步兵與傭兵守兩翼，中央前線是波希米亞與西里西亞步兵，後方留立陶宛與波蘭騎兵作預備隊。開戰後輕騎與韃靼先向莫斯科中央硬衝，把俄軍的騎兵預備隊引出來追擊，再突然分向兩側，俄軍正面撞上隱藏在林中的聯軍砲兵，兩翼同時合圍，軍心當場崩潰，聯軍追擊五公里才收手。聯軍自己的弱點同樣明顯：贏了奧爾沙之後，疲憊的聯軍無法在冬天前再把斯摩棱斯克圍起來，讓瓦西里三世爭取到整個冬天的加固時間，攻勢就這樣停在一座城下。立陶宛在別的戰線上用的是另一套辦法：一五一二年的西維利亞戰役以騎兵縱隊襲擾、分割與焚燒為主，避免與莫斯科主力正面會戰；一五二一年配合克里米亞汗國與喀山的攻勢，則是靠草原騎兵大範圍迂迴與火燒糧草，逼迫莫斯科答應納貢，而不是真的攻城奪地。守方那邊，立窩尼亞騎士團在多拉特與文登等地的守城靠的是城頭火槍與騎士的短程突擊，而圍城與反圍城的天平，最後仍然決定於糧道與季節。
tacticsEn: Muscovite method was an advance in column along the Vitebsk–Smolensk road. The allies probed the crossings of the Berezina, the Bobr and the Drut, and Moscow declined the engagement, marching on to a camp on the Krapivna between Orsha and Dubrovna. Chelyadnin judged that the allied army would have to cross at one of the two bridges over the Dnieper and split his force to hold those crossings; instead the allies bridged the river further north with two pontoon bridges, turned the Muscovite flank, and turned a weakness of divided defence into a fatal wound. In the order of battle the allies put the sixteen thousand horses of the grand duchy in the centre of the front, the Polish infantry and the mercenaries on the wings, the Bohemian and Silesian foot in the middle of the line, and Lithuanian and Polish cavalry in reserve behind. When the action opened, light horse and Tatars struck hard at the Muscovite centre to draw the Russian cavalry reserve forward in pursuit, then wheeled suddenly to both sides; the Russians ran headlong into the allied guns hidden in the wood, the two wings closed in at once, the army broke on the spot, and the allies pursued for five kilometres before stopping. The allies' own weakness was just as visible: after Orsha the exhausted army could not invest Smolensk again before winter, which gave Vasili III the whole winter to strengthen the town, and the offensive stalled beneath those walls. On the other fronts Lithuania used a different set of methods: the campaign in Severia in 1512 relied on mounted columns raiding, cutting the country and burning, deliberately avoiding a general engagement with the main Muscovite force; the campaign of 1521, made with the Crimean Khanate and Kazan, relied on wide-ranging steppe cavalry to turn the flank and burn the supplies, pressing Moscow into promising tribute rather than storming fortresses. On the defensive side the Livonian Order held Dorpat and Wenden with guns on the walls and short-range charges by the knights, and in the end the balance in siege and counter-siege was settled by the supply line and by the season.
data: 有根據的數字集中在幾個節點上。一五一二十二月莫斯科出兵，一五一三年對斯摩棱斯克先圍六週、再圍四週，兩次都告失敗，城池到一五一四年七月才陷落，隨後莫斯科接連占下克里切夫、姆斯特斯拉夫爾與杜布羅夫納。一五一二年間立陶宛最高軍事首領奧斯特羅斯基打敗約六千人的俄軍，並蹂躪西維利亞。奧爾沙一役的兵力眾說紛紜：齊格蒙特一世致信教宗良十世稱俄軍八萬，帝國外交官赫爾伯斯坦記聯軍不足三萬而俄軍八萬；波蘭史家波胡恩指這是宣傳數字，因為現存文件按名列出被俘貴族只有六百一十一人，而齊格蒙特宣稱斬首三萬、俘獲四十六名指揮官；另一份估計認為莫斯科軍約四萬；俄國史家洛賓按十四座城市的徵召能力推算全軍約一萬三千至一萬五千人，扣除損失、逃亡與留守斯摩棱斯克的人數，會戰時可能只剩約一萬二千人；另有研究認為瓦西里三世時代的大役兵員上限根本到不了兩萬。聯軍方面：齊格蒙特共集結約三萬五千人，其中波蘭人佔約百分之五十七；實際投入會戰者約三萬，四至五千人留在巴里索夫；騎兵三萬二千五百，傭兵步兵三千，大公國直屬騎兵一萬六千。戰果是奪下莫斯科軍營與全部三百門砲，追擊五公里。一五一九年莫斯科再入侵，襲擊奧爾沙、莫吉廖夫、明斯克、維捷布斯克與波洛茨克五城；一五二一年克里米亞汗馬赫默德·格來大軍打到莫斯科城下，莫斯科被迫承諾納貢。一五二二年訂下停戰五年、不交換囚犯、莫斯科保有斯摩棱斯克的條款，後來延長到一五三四年。領土帳面上，一五二二年立陶宛失去約五萬六千平方公里（包括斯摩棱斯克），而一四二九年它的版圖曾達九十三萬平方公里，到一五八三年只剩三十六萬五千平方公里。斯摩棱斯克此後近一百年一直在莫斯科手中，直到一六一一年才被波蘭-立陶宛聯邦收復。
dataEn: The grounded figures cluster around a few fixed points. Moscow marched in December 1512; the sieges of Smolensk in 1513 lasted six weeks and then four weeks and both failed, and the city did not fall until July 1514, after which Moscow seized Krichev, Mstislavl and Dubrovna in turn. In 1512 the Lithuanian grand hetman Ostrogski defeated a Russian force of some six thousand men and ravaged Severia. The numbers at Orsha are fiercely disputed: Sigismund I wrote to Pope Leo X of a horde of eighty thousand Muscovites, and the imperial diplomat Herberstein recorded fewer than thirty thousand allies against eighty thousand Russians; the Polish historian Bohun treats this as propaganda material, since the surviving documents name only six hundred and eleven captured nobles, while Sigismund claimed thirty thousand dead and forty-six commanders taken; another estimate puts the Muscovite army at about forty thousand; the Russian historian Lobin, calculating from the levy capacity of fourteen towns, arrives at a total of thirteen to fifteen thousand men, which, with losses, desertion and the garrison left in Smolensk deducted, might mean as few as twelve thousand men in the field at Orsha; and other work holds that the largest army Vasili III's state could field in a great campaign never reached twenty thousand. On the other side, Sigismund gathered about thirty-five thousand men, roughly fifty-seven per cent of them Poles; some thirty thousand were actually engaged, with four to five thousand left behind at Barysau; the force contained thirty-two thousand five hundred cavalry and three thousand mercenary infantry, of which sixteen thousand horses were the grand duchy’s own under Ostrogski. The result was the capture of the Muscovite camp and all three hundred of its guns, with a pursuit of five kilometres. In 1519 Moscow invaded again, raiding Orsha, Mogilev, Minsk, Vitebsk and Polotsk; in 1521 the Crimean khan Mehmed I Giray brought his horde to the walls of Moscow and the Muscovites were driven to promise tribute. In 1522 a five-year truce was concluded, without exchange of prisoners, with Russia keeping Smolensk, and it was later extended to 1534. On the territorial account, Lithuania lost about fifty-six thousand square kilometres in 1522, Smolensk among them, from a patchwork that had reached nine hundred and thirty thousand square kilometres in 1429 and was down to three hundred and sixty-five thousand by 1583. Smolensk stayed in Muscovite hands for close to a century afterwards and was not retaken by the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth until 1611.
cause: 導火線是簽了條約也沒解決的舊糾葛。一五〇八年十月八日那份所謂永久和平維持了一五〇三年的邊界，但兩國關係依然緊張：齊格蒙特一世要求引渡叛逃的米哈伊爾·格林斯基，瓦西里三世則要求立陶宛善待他已寡居的姊妹海倫娜——伊凡三世之女、亞歷山大的遺孀；瓦西里還查出齊格蒙特在出錢讓克里米亞汗明里·格來襲擊莫斯科大公國。更深一層是瓦西里三世自己的王位野心：一五〇六年亞歷山大大公去世後，他曾想借海倫娜的旗號爭取波蘭王位，失敗之後，維護東正教與替海倫娜撐腰，就成了莫斯科插手立陶宛內政的藉口。格林斯基的叛變（他被指控毒殺亞歷山大，一五〇八年殺死政敵扎布熱津斯基後率眾投奔莫斯科）則給莫斯科在立陶宛境內留了內應，使維爾納一帶的貴族分成兩派，國王派與樞密院派幾乎翻臉。最後是西線的意外之變：普魯士的阿爾布雷希特出任條頓騎士團大團長後，拒絕履行第二次托倫和約中向波蘭稱臣的義務，一五一九至二一年波蘭-條頓戰爭開打，神聖羅馬帝國皇帝馬克西米利安一世站到了瓦西里三世這一邊，莫斯科就此騰出全力東進。目標也很明確：斯摩棱斯克是立陶宛在東方的最後一個像樣堡壘，也是羅斯商人南下波蘭、匈牙利與克里米亞的貿易咽喉，控制它等於打開基輔羅斯古地的門戶；只要南方草原與東南邊境穩住，瓦西里三世就可以放手一搏。
causeEn: The trigger was an old quarrel that the treaty had not settled. The so-called eternal peace of 8 October 1508 held the border of 1503, yet the relations between the two states remained tense: Sigismund I demanded the extradition of the fugitive Michael Glinski, while Vasili III demanded that Lithuania treat his widowed sister Helena well, the daughter of Ivan III and the widow of Alexander; Vasili also discovered that Sigismund was paying the Crimean khan Meñli I Giray to attack the Muscovite principality. Deeper down lay Vasili's own dynastic ambition: after Alexander died in 1506 he had tried to capture the Polish crown under the banner of Helena, and after that had failed the defence of the Orthodox and the cause of the dowager became the pretext by which Moscow interfered in Lithuanian domestic politics. The Glinski rising, in which he was accused of poisoning Alexander and in 1508 killed his rival Jan Zabrzeziński before going over to Moscow, left the Muscovites an agent inside Lithuania and split the nobles around Vilnius into a royal party and a council party that nearly came to blows. The last turn came in the west: when Albrecht of Prussia became grand master of the Teutonic Order he refused to perform the homage to Poland required by the Second Peace of Thorn, the Polish–Teutonic War of 1519–1521 broke out, and the emperor Maximilian I took the side of Vasili III, freeing Moscow to concentrate everything on the east. The objective was plain: Smolensk was the last serious fortress Lithuania held in the east and the commercial throat through which Ruthenian merchants moved south toward Poland, Hungary and the Crimea, and to hold it was to open the door to the old lands of Kievan Rus. With the southern steppe and the southeastern frontier held quiet, Vasili III could afford to stake everything on it.
impact: 此役的帳，最後是立陶宛用土地付的。一五二二年之後，它在東翼的大門被打開，克里切夫、姆斯特斯拉夫爾、杜布羅夫納與斯摩棱斯克接連易主，莫斯科第一次在西界站到第聶伯河與別列津納河一線，基輔羅斯古地的門戶朝它打開了半扇；立陶宛的版圖則從一四二九年的九十三萬平方公里一路縮到一五八三年的三十六萬五千平方公里。政治上，此役把波蘭與立陶宛兩套軍事的機器第一次焊在一起：波蘭王室的正規軍、桑波利尼斯基率領的貴族私兵與王宮近衛，同奧斯特羅斯基的立陶宛土地軍在同一面旗下作戰；奧爾沙勝利之後送往羅馬的頌詞把這場勝仗包裝成基督教世界的旗幟，波蘭-立陶宛的聯合在歐洲外交上的分量由此上升，十六年後齊格蒙特一世的兒子終於推動盧布林聯合、成立波蘭-立陶宛聯邦。南方草原線也由此惡化：一五二一年克里米亞汗國與喀山的聯手打到莫斯科城下，瓦西里三世被迫承諾納貢，此後莫斯科對草原的依賴成為它在伊凡四世時期最頑固的弱點之一。條頓騎士團方面，阿爾布雷希特在波蘭-條頓戰爭中敗於齊格蒙特一世，騎士團此後逐步向波蘭靠攏，這條線最後在十六世紀末變成波蘭直接接管立窩尼亞的伏筆。軍事技術上，奧爾沙是歐洲史上第一場以騎兵衝鋒、佯退翻轉與林中隱蔽砲兵直接壓垮大公國步騎混合大軍的戰役；莫斯科由此看清自己的徵召與後勤撐不起遠征，斯摩棱斯克慘案的教訓最終推動了伊凡四世時代俄軍火砲數量的暴增，以及在立窩尼亞戰爭中對歐洲火砲的大規模採購。
impactEn: The bill for this war was ultimately paid by Lithuania in land. After 1522 its eastern door stood open, Krichev, Mstislavl, Dubrovna and Smolensk changed hands in turn, and Moscow for the first time stood on the line of the Dnieper and the Berezina in the west, with half the door to the old lands of Kievan Rus swung open in its favour; Lithuania's patchwork shrank from nine hundred and thirty thousand square kilometres in 1429 to three hundred and sixty-five thousand by 1583. Politically the war welded together the two military machines of Poland and Lithuania for the first time: the regular royal army of Poland, the private retainers of the magnates and the royal guard under Sampoliński, and the Lithuanian land army of Ostrogski all fought under one flag, and the panegyrics sent to Rome after Orsha dressed the victory up as the banner of Christendom, raising the diplomatic weight of the Polish–Lithuanian union; sixteen years later the son of Sigismund I would carry that process through to the Union of Lublin and the Commonwealth. The southern steppe line worsened as well: in 1521 the Crimea and Kazan together brought their host to the walls of Moscow and Vasili III was driven to promise tribute, and Moscow's dependence on the steppe became one of the most stubborn of its weaknesses in the time of Ivan IV. On the Teutonic side, Albrecht lost to Sigismund I in the Polish–Teutonic War and the order drifted progressively toward Poland, a line that ended in the late sixteenth century as Poland's direct takeover of Livonia. On the technical level Orsha was the first battle in European history in which cavalry charge, feigned retreat and concealed artillery in the woods broke a Muscovite army of mixed foot and horse, and Moscow saw clearly from it that its levy and its supply could not carry a distant campaign; the lesson of Smolensk eventually drove the great growth in the number of Russian guns under Ivan IV and the large-scale purchase of European artillery in the Livonian War.
result: 一五一二年的冬天，莫斯科先把矛頭指向斯摩棱斯克；一五一三年六週與四週的兩次圍攻都失敗；一五一四年七月城池終於陷落，瓦西里·舒伊斯基被派去做攝政，格林斯基的期望破滅，人也被軟禁。莫斯科一度得意，東進占下克里切夫、姆斯特斯拉夫爾與杜布羅夫納，但一五一四年九月八日奧爾沙一戰把這一切都打回原形：切利亞德寧與布爾加科夫-戈利察分兵守渡口、失去側翼協調，聯軍在克拉皮夫納河畔用騎兵硬衝、林中砲火與兩翼合圍擊潰莫斯科軍，軍營與三百門砲全部落入聯軍手中，聯軍追擊五公里。此後聯軍雖勝，卻因疲憊無法在冬天前再圍斯摩棱斯克，讓莫斯科爭取到一整季的加固時間，戰局就這樣僵在城下。莫斯科的西進被壓了四年，到一五一九年才又捲土重來，襲擊奧爾沙、莫吉廖夫、明斯克、維捷布斯克與波洛茨克五城；一五二一年齊格蒙特一世打敗條頓大團長，與喀山、克里米亞結盟，汗國大軍打到莫斯科城下，瓦西里三世被迫承諾納貢，達什科維率領的立陶宛軍也趁勢北上想把梁贊拿下。戰爭最後以一五二二年的條約收場：停戰五年、不交換囚犯、莫斯科保有斯摩棱斯克，條約後來延長到一五三四年。雙方都沒有取得決定性的勝利——莫斯科用一座城換走一次慘敗，立陶宛保住了國家卻失去東翼，斯摩棱斯克在莫斯科手中又留了將近一百年，直到一六一一年才被聯邦收復；而在此後的十年之間，整個東歐的邊界都沿著第聶伯河與別列津納河重新劃定。
resultEn: In the winter of 1512 Moscow turned its spearhead on Smolensk; the two sieges of 1513, of six weeks and of four weeks, both failed; in July 1514 the city fell at last, Vasily Nemoy Shuysky was sent to govern it, and Glinski's expectations were disappointed even as he was put under house arrest. Moscow was briefly triumphant, pushing east to take Krichev, Mstislavl and Dubrovna, but the battle of Orsha on 8 September 1514 threw all of it back: Chelyadnin and Bulgakov-Golitsa had split their force to hold the crossings and lost the coordination of their flank, and on the Krapivna the allies broke the Muscovite army with a charge of horse, with the guns hidden in the wood and with a pincer on both wings, taking the camp and all three hundred of the guns, then pursuing for five kilometres. The allies could not follow up: too exhausted, they did not invest Smolensk again before winter, which gave Moscow a full season to strengthen the town, and the war froze beneath those walls. Moscow's advance westward was held for four years and resumed in 1519 with raids on Orsha, Mogilev, Minsk, Vitebsk and Polotsk; in 1521 Sigismund I defeated the grand master of the Teutonic Order, allied with Kazan and the Crimea, and brought the horde to the walls of Moscow, where Vasili III was forced to promise tribute, while Dashkovich's Lithuanian troops pushed north in the hope of taking Ryazan. The war ended with the treaty of 1522: a five-year truce, no exchange of prisoners, and Smolensk left in Russian hands, extended in 1534. Neither side won decisively — Moscow traded a city for a catastrophe, Lithuania kept the state but lost the eastern wing, Smolensk stayed in Muscovite hands for close to a century until the Commonwealth retook it in 1611, and over the decade that followed the frontier of eastern Europe was redrawn along the Dnieper and the Berezina.
